title: Jamaican Keto Frankfurter Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy stew made with jamaican seasoned frankfurters and a blend of aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Jamaican Frankfurters
ingredients.notes: Make sure to choose a keto-friendly brand

ingredients.name: Oily
ingredients.notes: Avocado or coconut oil work well

ingredients.name: Garlicky
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic adds depth to the stew

ingredients.name: Stew
ingredients.notes: Use a low-carb stew mix or make your own

ingredients.name: Frankfurter Seasoning
ingredients.notes: Add a Jamaican flair with this seasoning blend

instructions: Heat the oily in a large skillet over medium-high heat
Add the garlicky and cook for 1 minute until fragrant
Add the stew mix and cook according to package instructions
Add the Jamaican frankfurters and cook for an additional 5 minutes
Season with Frankfurter seasoning and stir to combine
